INSTRUCTION.INSTRUCTIONTEXT:
General Instructions

  1. Total duration of the examination is minutes.
  2. The countdown timer at the top right shows the time remaining. The examination ends automatically when the timer reaches zero.
  3. Use the question palette on the right to move between questions.
  4. Click Save & Next to save your answer and move to the next question.
  5. Do not close, refresh or navigate away from the examination window.
